name: Freelancer or consultant
description: Clients, proposals, deadlines and getting paid. Operations tracks deliverables and invoices, GTM drafts proposals and follow-ups.

chief-of-staff: Show every client deadline in the next 7 days in the morning briefing.
Flag any invoice unpaid after 14 days.
gtm: Proposals state scope, price range, timeline and what is not included.
ops: Never agree to new scope in a draft; list it for the owner to decide.

skills.name: client-invoice-follow-up
skills.description: Use when an invoice is overdue.
steps: Search memory for the invoice, amount and due date
Draft a friendly reminder with the amount and date
Offer a simple way to pay
Create an issue to check again in 7 days

skills.name: project-kickoff
skills.description: Use when a new client project starts.
steps: Save the client, contact and deadline to memory
Create issues for each deliverable with dates
Draft a kickoff note confirming scope and next meeting

issues.title: List active clients with their next deadline

interview.priorities: Deliver the Acme rebrand; find two new clients
